learning_outcomes.text: Knows and understands the need for electricity generation based on various energy carriers.
Has knowledge about the functioning of conventional thermal power plants.
Knows and understands methods of electricity generation based on alternative energy sources.
Can calculate the efficiency of power plants for various power plant block connection schemes.
Can calculate the operating parameters of a power plant and its blocks.
Is aware of the negative impact of conventional electricity generation on the natural environment and the need to limit or eliminate it.

syllabus_topics: Characteristic values for thermal process calculations in power plants.
Basic calculations of boiler heat balance. Fuel combustion.
Steam turbine efficiency. Thermal cycle efficiency.
Energy balance of power plant system elements.
Solar power plants – photovoltaic installations.
Calculations of basic parameters of hydroelectric power plants.
Calculations of basic parameters of small wind turbines.

Classification and elements of power plants. Division of power plants according to various criteria. Basic role of thermal power plants in electricity generation. Elements of the technological process of a conventional thermal power plant. Impact of power plants on the environment. Nuisance of power plant impact on nature - emission of pollutants from thermal power plants.

Thermal cycle of a conventional power plant. Physical state of the working fluid - water-steam. i-s, T-s diagrams of water vapor. Carnot, Rankine thermal cycle. Thermal cycle efficiency. Actions improving cycle efficiency.

Professional steam power plants. Principle of boiler operation. Basic technical data of professional power boilers. Types of steam turbines. Principle of turbine operation in a thermal cycle. Basic parameters of power turbines. Steam condenser in the power plant thermal cycle.
Combined heat and power generation. Basics of combined electricity and heat generation. Efficiency of combined heat and power plants. Schematics of typical combined heat and power plant systems.
Gas turbine power plants. Gas-steam cycles in gas turbine power plants. Gas-steam systems integrated with coal gasification.

Hydroelectric power plants. Division and general characteristics of hydroelectric power plants. Utilization of sea energy. Principle of operation of inland hydroelectric power plants. Hydrotechnical structures. Elements of hydroelectric power plants. Solutions for hydro turbines.
Pumped-storage power plants. Construction of pumped-storage power plants. Use of hydroelectric power plants to regulate the operation of the power system.
Wind power plants. Types of wind power plants. Constructions of wind power plants. Power generation characteristics. Utilization of wind energy in Poland.

Solar power plants. Solar thermal power plants. Construction and principle of operation of heliothermal power plants. Solar collectors. Photovoltaic (helioelectric) cells. Construction and basics of cell operation.
Nuclear power plants. Nuclear power reactors. Thermal systems of nuclear power plants with selected reactor types.
Geothermal power plants. Utilization of Earth's internal energy. Characteristics of geothermal sources. Construction and operation of geothermal power plants. Geothermal sources in Poland.
Fuel cells. Principle of operation of selected fuel cells. Types of fuel cells. Use of cells for electricity production. Use of hydrogen as fuel.
Electrical systems of power plants. Electric generators. Construction of generators. Characteristic parameters of generators. Electrical systems for power output from power plants.
Operation of power plants in the energy system. Tasks of power plants in the safe management of the power system operation.
teaching_methods: Practice method (doing tasks at the blackboard)
assessment_rules: Student participation in lectures is expected for learning course content. For auditorium classes, students must prepare for exercises as indicated by the instructor, potentially through task sets. Assessment in auditorium classes may be based on oral or written statements in the form of colloquia, which contribute to the final grade for this form of activity.
